spark_open.description: The creature is a chimeric animal shown in right-facing profile standing on a small patch of ground. It has the overall body shape, fur, head, hind legs and long bushy tail of a red fox, but with large feathered wings and a feathered chest patch in place of forelimbs. The fur is reddish-orange on the head, neck, back, sides and tail with white on the muzzle, throat, chest and belly and darker brown-black on the lower hind legs. The two wings are folded against the sides of the body and show the mottled tan, cream, grey and brown patterning with dark spots and bars typical of a barn owl. The animal stands upright on its hind legs with its tail extending behind it along the ground.

meta_spark.description: A single upright creature with the head, fur, hind legs and long bushy tail of a red fox standing in a crouched bipedal posture on its hind feet, facing right. Its torso sides bear two large folded feathered wings mottled in tan, brown, grey and white with dark spots and bars like a barn owl, and its chest and shoulders are covered in pale spotted owl-like feathers. The fox fur is reddish-orange above with white on the muzzle, throat and underside.
